slug: 明尊第九十六章西方颢天沧海横流
content_zh:
第1章金手指成精啦！
传承百万载，曾是此界道门源头的楼观道已经是一片火海，一团团雷光肆虐，炸碎了这终南山上的古朴楼观。
再悠久的传承，数百万年的风风雨雨过来，也会有起有落。
楼观道如今只有几位道门羽士潜修，全宗上下，不过十数人，早已没落，今日更是给人杀了个干净。
两道血光从楼观道祖地冲天而起……
这两道遁光中的一人，浑身裹在血光中，只露出一双阴鸠三角眼，浑身魔气森森，不似好人，他咬着牙，心疼的从怀里掏出一张金色的符箓，上面的符文古朴晦涩，灵光凝结。
“现在不是舍不得的时候！”另一道血光中有人疾呼。
“说的容易，这可是老子三百道德兑换的纵地金光遁符……尽了我准备用来炼制本命法宝的全部功德。”虽然口中如此说，但那人还是果断捏碎了那张金色符箓，登时纵起一道金光，挟着两人遁入虚空，消失的无影无踪。
这时楼观道上空，才有几个身影赶到。其中一位白发长眉，下颌五缕长须飘荡胸前的老者看着已经是一片废墟的楼观道，怒吼一声。
“贼子尔敢！”
老者一挥袖袍，登时无量庆云滚滚升腾，只是一压，便灭去了下方炽烈的魔焰。
那青色庆云翻滚激荡，携着无穷之威，足以毁山摧城的一团团雷光和无物不燃的九幽魔火被这庆云一沾，随即磨灭，竟然没有激起丝毫的声息。
那庆云本是祥和之气，如今滚荡的如同劫云一般，可见老者心中之怒。
另一位中年道人也是面色凝重，对左右道：“楼观道乃是我们太上道三宗之一，道祖昔年讲道亲传的道统，地位非比寻常。今日这两个魔头修为低微，却胆大包天，将楼观道灭门。又能拿出前古真符遁走，此事十分蹊跷。”
“待我以太乙六爻遁法推算这两个贼子的下落，定要挖出幕后主使！”
“我等太上道统，定要同心协力，就算把天桶一个窟窿，也要报此仇！”
一众元神真仙具是极怒，纷纷点头应和，就算幕后主使者是魔道两个顶级魁首——血海道、九幽宗。也要让他们血债血偿！
说罢，那中年道人便掐指起卦，右手爆出无数复杂的指诀，让人眼缭乱的指影重重，最终如承托着什么般，豁然摊开，向上一抬。
“轰～”
无量灵光涌现……

这中年道人已是此界天机术算的大宗师，随手起卦推算，本应是轻描淡写，不漏痕迹，有返璞归真之相。但今日楼观道灭门，他竟然毫无所觉，已经是怒极。当下不再收束法力，全力施为，千里之内天地元气翻腾，大道显化。
一众元神真仙，皆映照在这一抹灵光之下，透过光华望去，神色都显得朦胧了起来，强横的气息扫荡八方，远在千万里外，一处气息如渊的深邃所在，八臂魔神凭空显化，仰天怒吼，欲与这般气息平分秋色。西极灵山之上，无数庙宇林立，那滚滚威压横扫而至的时候，灵山顶上，一朵金莲盛开，囊括须弥，将威压轻轻挡在外面，护住了西方一片净土。
一张太极图显现，将那八臂魔神一卷，砸到九幽之下，又要强行破开金莲。
灵山顶上，一座仅能容纳一身的小庙中，传出一声悠长的叹息：“太上道诸位道友，此事与我佛门无关。”便主动放开了金莲，让那太极图查看气息。
南方蛮荒大山……
东海三座仙岛……
中土皇朝气运所在……
四方显化无数异象，都隐隐抗衡着这股横扫天下的气息，这时候昆仑山上有白玉如意显化，海外诸岛之上浮起一柄仙剑，与太上道一众元神真仙联手所化的太极图合在一处，将四方异象全数压下……
三脉气运居高临下，犹如俯瞰此界众生一般。
一众元神真仙气息凛然，借此之威，穷搜天下所气机，化为天机脉络显现。
那无量灵光，缓缓聚拢起来，最终化作了八卦符文，相互交感，衍生无数金爻。一众元神真仙纷纷摄取金爻，推算未来大衍天机，此次太上道如此大张旗鼓，甚至请动元始道，灵宝道两宗元神真人出手，非但要抓住凶手，更是要借机卜算未来五百年天机。
“竟有大劫将至之兆！莫非传承百万年的楼观道灭门，便是量劫将起之先兆？”
“五百年内，却有大劫将至的迹象，但量劫酷烈，肆虐甚久，一场劫数绵延万年都只是小可，来势缓缓，去势汹汹，纵然有些兆头，数千年内，也未必能掀起劫数。而且每逢四百九十年一次四九小劫，每逢万年一次群仙大劫。这未必是量劫之兆，也许只是四九小劫或群仙大劫……”
一众元神真人议论之时，中年道人蓦地睁开双目，竟然有些惊疑不定。
“怎么可能？竟然算不到这两个贼子的因果。”
“好似不在此界之内，不入天机之中。”中年道人面色凝重道：“楼观道灭门之事也天机紊乱，似乎有大神通者遮蔽因果。”
“不过这股屏蔽天机之力，只有一个时辰。”
广陵城中一处普通民居内，先前两个凶手望着那横扫天下的恐怖气息，又惊又怕，其中一身黑袍的道人对一脸凶横的三角眼说道：“妙空，你不是说楼观道已经没落，全派修为最高的，不过一结丹修士，还是一个道行之士，轻易就能拿下吗？”
“结果居然引来这么多元神真仙，这气息之强，怕是比我们那一界所有元神加起来都多！”
“通神老道，你怕什么。我们不是已经拿下了楼观道？元神真仙神通再广大，难道还能算清轮回之主屏蔽的因果吗？诸天轮回之主是何等大能，派遣我们降临此界完成任务，早就镇压了我们的一身因果。就是天仙道君也算不出来……”

三角眼的妙空虽然也有后怕，但还是硬着嘴道。
“我不管这些，你答应我的东西，别忘了就是。”通神老道想起轮回之主的大能，也稍稍平复了心境。
“而且，你自身的因果被轮回之主镇压。但你从楼观道抢走的东西可没有，待到一个时辰后，任务完成。轮回之主蒙蔽的天机就会逐渐明朗，怕是下一瞬，便会有元神真仙来取你性命，到时候在元神真仙手下，你求死都难。”
content_en:
Chapter 1 Goldfinger has become a spirit!
Passed down for millions of years, Louguan Dao, which was once the source of the Taoist gates in this world, has become a sea of ​​fire. Balls of lightning raged and shattered the ancient Louguan on Zhongnan Mountain.
No matter how long the inheritance is, there will be ups and downs after millions of years of ups and downs.
There are only a few Taoist Taoist priests in Louguan Taoism now. The entire sect, only a dozen of them, have long since declined, and today they were all killed.
Two rays of blood soared into the sky from Louguan Taoist Ancestral Land...
One of the two escaping lights was covered in blood, with only a pair of sinister doves and triangular eyes exposed. He was full of demonic aura and did not look like a good person. He gritted his teeth and took out a golden talisman from his arms with distress. The runes on it were simple and obscure, and the aura was condensed.
"Now is not the time to be reluctant!" Someone shouted in another bloody light.
"It's easy to say, this is the vertical golden light escape talisman that I exchanged for 300 morals... It has fulfilled all the merits that I plan to use to refine the natal magic weapon." Although he said so, the man still decisively crushed the golden talisman, and immediately a golden light erupted, carrying the two of them into the void, and disappeared without a trace.
At this time, a few figures arrived above Louguan Road. One of them, an old man with white hair and long eyebrows, and five long beards floating on his chin, roared angrily when he looked at Lou Guandao, which was already in ruins.
"How dare you, thief!"
The old man waved his sleeves and robes, and immeasurable clouds of joy immediately rose up. With just one press, the blazing demonic flames below were extinguished.
The blue Qingyun rolled and stirred, carrying infinite power. The lightning that could destroy mountains and cities and the Nine Nether Demonic Fires that were incombustible were touched by the Qingyun and were immediately wiped out without making the slightest sound.
The Qingyun was originally a peaceful aura, but now it was rolling like a calamity cloud, which showed the anger in the old man's heart.
Another middle-aged Taoist also looked solemn and said to the left and right: "Louguan Taoism is one of the three sects of our Taishang Taoism. The Taoist tradition was taught by the Taoist ancestors in the past and has an extraordinary status. Today, these two demons are of low cultivation, but they are so bold that they wiped out the Louguan Taoist family. It is very strange that they can take out the ancient true talisman and escape."
"When I calculate the whereabouts of these two thieves using the Six Yao Escape Method of Tai Yi, I will definitely dig out the mastermind behind them!"
"We, the Supreme Taoists, must work together and take revenge even if there is a hole in the sky bucket!"
All the True Immortals of the Yuan Shen were extremely angry and nodded in agreement, even though the masterminds behind the scenes were the two top leaders of the Demonic Dao - Blood Sea Dao and Jiuyou Sect. We must also make them pay with blood!
After saying that, the middle-aged Taoist started to make hexagrams with his fingers, and countless complicated finger formulas burst out from his right hand. The dazzling shadows of his fingers were numerous. Finally, as if he was holding something, he suddenly spread them out and raised them upwards.
"Boom~"
Infinite spiritual light emerges...
This middle-aged Taoist is already the great master of heavenly arithmetic in this world. He makes predictions casually, which should be done lightly and without leaking any traces. He has the appearance of returning to his original nature. But today, Lou Guan Tao destroyed his family, and he didn't even notice, and he was already very angry. At this moment, he no longer restrained his magic power and used all his strength. Within a thousand miles, the vitality of heaven and earth surged, and the great road manifested.
All the souls and true immortals were reflected in this spiritual light. Looking through the light, their expressions became hazy. The powerful aura swept in all directions. Thousands of miles away, in a deep place where the aura was like an abyss, the eight-armed demon appeared out of thin air and roared to the sky, hoping to be equal to this aura. On the Lingshan Mountain in the West, there are countless temples. When the rolling pressure swept across, a golden lotus bloomed on the top of the Lingshan Mountain, covering Xumi, gently blocking the pressure from the outside, and protecting a pure land in the west.
A Tai Chi diagram appeared, throwing a roll of the eight-armed demon under Jiuyou, and trying to break the golden lotus by force.
On the top of Lingshan Mountain, in a small temple that could only accommodate one person, a long sigh came out: "Fellow Taoists of Taishang Dao, this matter has nothing to do with my Buddhism." He took the initiative to let go of the golden lotus and let the Tai Chi diagram check the breath.
Southern BarbarianWild mountains...
Three fairy islands in the East China Sea...
The fate of the dynasty of China...
Countless visions manifested in all directions, all faintly contending with this aura sweeping the world. At this time, white jade Ruyi appeared on Kunlun Mountain, and a fairy sword floated on the overseas islands. Together with the Tai Chi diagram formed by the Taishang Dao and the True Immortals of the Yuan Shen, they suppressed all the visions in the four directions...
The three channels of energy are condescending, as if overlooking all living beings in this world.
The aura of all the true immortals of the primordial spirit was awe-inspiring, and with this power, they searched for all the qi secrets in the world and turned them into the celestial secrets.
The infinite spiritual light slowly gathered together, and finally turned into Bagua runes, which interacted with each other and gave rise to countless golden yarns. A group of Yuanshen True Immortals took the golden yarns one after another to predict the secrets of the future. This time, Taishang Dao was so vigorous that they even invited Yuanshi Dao and Lingbao Dao to take action. Not only did they want to catch the murderer, but they also took the opportunity to divine the secrets of the next five hundred years.
"There are signs of an impending catastrophe! Could it be that the Louguan Taoism, which has been passed down for millions of years, is the harbinger of an impending catastrophe?"
"Within five hundred years, there are signs of an imminent catastrophe, but the calamity is fierce and raging for a long time. A calamity that lasts for tens of thousands of years is just a trivial matter. It comes slowly and goes away fiercely. Even if there are some signs, it may not be possible to cause a calamity within thousands of years. Moreover, the Forty-nine Small Catastrophes happen every four hundred and ninety years, and the Immortal Catastrophe happens once every ten thousand years. This may not be a sign of calamity, maybe it is just the Forty-nine Small Catastrophes or the Immortal Catastrophe..."
While all the Yuanshen Daoists were discussing, the middle-aged Taoist suddenly opened his eyes, somewhat surprised and confused.
"How is it possible? The cause and effect of these two thieves cannot be calculated."
"It seems that it is not within this world, and it is not included in the heaven's secret." The middle-aged Taoist said with a solemn face: "The destruction of the Louguan Taoist family is also a disorder of the heaven's secret. It seems that someone with great supernatural powers is covering up the cause and effect."
"But this power to shield the secrets only lasts for an hour."
In an ordinary residence in Guangling City, the two murderers were shocked and frightened when they looked at the terrifying aura sweeping across the world. One of the Taoists in black robes said to the menacing triangular eyes: "Miaokong, didn't you say that Louguan Taoism has declined? The highest cultivation level in the whole sect, but the Yijie Dan monk is still a Taoist practitioner, can he be easily taken down?"
"As a result, we actually attracted so many true immortals from multiple gods. This aura is probably more powerful than all the souls in our world put together!"
"Old Taoist Tongshen, what are you afraid of? Haven't we already captured the Louguan Tao? No matter how powerful the Yuanshen True Immortal's magical power is, can we still calculate the cause and effect blocked by the Lord of Samsara? The Lord of Samsara in the heavens is so powerful. He sent us to this world to complete the task and suppressed our cause and effect long ago. Even the Celestial Immortal Taoist Lord can't calculate it..."
Although the triangular-eyed Miaokong was also scared, he still said it bravely.
"I don't care about these things. Don't forget what you promised me." The old Taoist Tongshen thought of the power of the Lord of Reincarnation and calmed down a little.
"Moreover, your own cause and effect has been suppressed by the Lord of Reincarnation. But there is nothing you snatched from Louguan Dao. After an hour, the task will be completed. The secret of the Lord of Reincarnation will gradually become clear. I am afraid that in the next moment, the True Immortal Yuanshen will come to take your life. At that time, it will be difficult for you to die under the hands of the True Immortal Yuanshen."
